body:
## Change

F1. Track closed reader state. If teardown wins while final session verification is pending, release newly acquired immutable-ref lease and fail with CONTENT_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE. Reject later acquisitions; make close idempotent.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN exercises production reader/acquireContentLease with controlled verification and Web Locks fixture. Parent inspected legacy runtime caller and close/acquire paths, reran 38 reader/installer tests. Worker related plus boundaries: 90, typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. Legacy content reader lifecycle; no native browser Web Locks timing proof. Regression stubs verification/storage while executing actual lease coordination. Full repository/browser suites not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(content): release session lease when reader closes
